name: Building a Library

steps.t: Find the library in the City Center
steps.go: Head to the library in the middle of Buried City, just north of Marano Park. The books are all in the big room overlooking the park.

steps.t: Find a romance book
steps.go: In the main hall, check the display stand by the window facing the metro entrance, in front of the toppled bookcase.

steps.t: Find a detective book
steps.go: Take the west stairs up to the balcony and check the display stand at the top.

steps.t: Find an adventure book
steps.go: Carry on east along the balcony; the last book is on the stand to your left.

steps.t: Deliver three books to Apollo
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the books, the nearby metro station is quickest, then hand them to Apollo.

notes: Both guides agree on library location, three books and delivery. The wiki names the genres (romance, detective, adventure); PC Gamer says the items are all just 'Library Books' and order does not matter, so the genre to 1st/2nd/3rd pin pairing is not verified.

name: Communication Hideout

steps.t: Reach the Red Tower in Old Town
steps.go: Make for the Red Tower in Old Town and drop into its courtyard. Everything must be done in one raid.

steps.t: Find missing battery cell
steps.go: Look on the courtyard floor opposite the generator, by a small bag next to a metal unit.

steps.t: Install battery cell in the Generator
steps.pin: Install The Battery And Enable The Generator
steps.go: Slot the battery into the open panel on the generator in the same courtyard.

steps.t: Enable the power on the Generator
steps.pin: Install The Battery And Enable The Generator
steps.go: Use the generator's control panel on its front or right side to switch it on.

steps.t: Boot the antenna terminal near the Red Tower
steps.go: From the generator, climb through the window to the stairwell, go up, take the ladder to the roof and turn right. The yellow box is round the corner.

notes: Two MetaForge pins cover step 1 ('Reach The Red Tower' and 'Reach the Red Tower in Old Town'); the second is an alternative marker for the same step. No extraction needed once the terminal is booted.

name: Eyes on the Prize

steps.t: Find the secluded roof terrace southwest of the Southern Station
steps.pin: Find the roof terrace with blue tarps
steps.go: Bring three Wires. Rooftop-hop from Plaza Rosa towards the Southern Station and look for the roof covered in blue tarps.

steps.t: Rewire the solar panel using 3 Wires
steps.pin: Find the roof terrace with blue tarps
steps.go: On the tarp roof, find the solar panel beside a generator and some bushes, and interact once.

notes: Wiki and Prima say southwest of Southern Station, GamesRadar says west, wiki dialogue says south; all put it near the station. The generic 'Eyes on the Prize' pin is a quest marker not tied to a specific step by any guide, so it is unused. No extraction needed.

name: A Reveal in Ruins

steps.t: Search for an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in Buried City
steps.go: Go to any Farmacia, the green cross signs, such as the one on Piazza Arbusto or Piazza Rosa. The analyser sits by the checkout counter.

steps.t: Deliver the ESR Analyzer to Lance
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract with the analyser, a safe pocket helps, and give it to Lance.

notes: MetaForge id 'esr-analyzer' is the quest A Reveal in Ruins. Pins 'ESR Analyzer in Pharmacy' and 'A Parmacy for ESR Analyzer' (sic) are further alternative pharmacies for the same step. Must be done in one raid.

name: Marked for Death

steps.t: Reach the Su Durante Warehouses in the Outskirts in Buried City
steps.go: Head out to the Su Durante Warehouses on the Outskirts, a cluster of several buildings.

steps.t: Search for Tian Wen's cache near the Warehouses
steps.go: Walk round the outside walls of the warehouses; the cache is set against one of them, marked by a red ribbon.

steps.t: Follow the clues
steps.go: Track the footprints from the cache through the gap in the fence and into the shrubs on the dune, then interact at the end.

notes: Steps agree. Minor detail difference: wiki puts the cache on the north side of the building, All Things How says players usually find it on the west-facing side.

name: Industrial Espionage

steps.t: Locate Tian Wen's weapon cache by the Gas Station in the Outskirts
steps.go: Bring the Burletta Tian Wen gives you. Hug the map edge to the Gas Station on the Outskirts; try just south of it if nothing triggers.

steps.t: Bring a Burletta to the rival weapon cache
steps.go: Carry the Burletta to the rival cache and place it there.

steps.t: Place a listening device on the rival cache
steps.go: Interact with the rival cache again to plant the bug.

notes: rival cache spot not described by any guide, so unpinned

name: Unexpected Initiative

steps.t: Reach the Grandioso Apartments in Buried City
steps.pin: Reach the Grandioso Apartments in Buried City
steps.go: Go to the Grandioso Apartments. Both meters must be found in one raid.

steps.t: Search the Grandioso Apartments rooftop for a Moisture Meter
steps.go: Zipline to the top floor, take the stairs to the roof and check the gardening corner by two soil pots.

steps.t: Reach Piazza Roma in Buried City
steps.pin: Reach Piazza Roma in Buried City
steps.go: Head north to Piazza Roma.

steps.t: Search the broken rooftop gardens at Piazza Roma for a Nutrient Meter
steps.go: Zipline up to the building with the wrecked garden, climb the stairwell to the roof and look by a tank and a tub of soil.
steps.show: By the tank and soil tub.

steps.t: Deliver the Nutrient Meter to Tian Wen
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Extract and hand the Nutrient Meter to Tian Wen.

steps.t: Deliver the Moisture Meter to Tian Wen
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Give Tian Wen the Moisture Meter as well.

notes: GameTyrant folds the two deliveries into one 'return to Tian Wen'; the wiki lists them separately. GameTyrant mentions a December 2025 completion bug.

name: A Warm Place to Rest

steps.t: Locate the Abandoned Highway Camp
steps.go: Get up onto the raised highway, via rooftops if needed, and find the camp on it.

steps.t: Search for any signs of survivors
steps.go: Check the yellow-marked backpack beside the vehicle entrance at the camp.

steps.t: Follow the red markers
steps.go: Follow the red markers along the highway to where it collapses into Piazza Arbusto, then on towards the Buried Properties.

steps.t: Inspect the grave
steps.go: Find the grave near the Buried Properties and interact with it.

notes: Trader from the wiki (PC Gamer does not name one). PC Gamer folds the survivor search into the camp step; the wiki lists it separately.

name: Combat Recon

steps.t: Find and scope out a cover spot in the Parking Garage staircases
steps.go: Zipline to the Parking Garage roof, go to the south-west stairwell and interact at the top by the broken railing.

steps.t: Find and scope out a cover spot in the buses near Marano Park
steps.go: Get in the bus nearest the metro entrance at Marano Park and interact at its back door.

steps.t: Find and scope out a cover spot in the attics around Main Street
steps.go: Go up into the attic of the westernmost house on Plaza Rosa and interact by the roof window over the square.

steps.t: Destroy 2 Spotters
steps.go: Take out two Spotters; they hang around the Parking Garage, Marano Park and Plaza Rosa.

steps.t: Deliver a Spotter Relay to Shani
steps.go: Delivery in Speranza. Loot a Spotter Relay from a Spotter, extract and give it to Shani.

notes: Cover spots can be done in any order and across raids. 'Attic's cover spot' is a second MetaForge pin for the attic step (alternative spot).

name: Line in the Sand

steps.t: Find out why the train never reached Marano Station
steps.go: Go to the derailed blue train cars on the tracks south of Marano Station, between the Warehouse and Piazza Roma. Getting close updates it.

steps.t: Find out who orchestrated the robbery
steps.go: Head east to the small square tower on the hill, climb the railing and grab the detonator in the bush in its south-west corner.

steps.t: Find out where the thruster valves were stashed
steps.go: Walk into the ruined building at the Market Ruins; no interaction needed.

steps.t: Search the basement of the merchant's nearby apartment
steps.go: Go uphill to Dune's End, enter the building, go through the door ahead and zipline down to the basement. Photograph the stack of boxes.

notes: Trader from the wiki only (PC Gamer and FinalBoss do not name one). 'Investigate the stopped train' is a second MetaForge pin for step 1. FinalBoss says it describes the Riven Tides version; steps match PC Gamer and the wiki.

steps.t: Locate the flooded solar panels near the Grandioso Apartments
steps.go: Bring 5 Wires and 2 Batteries. Go to the street on the east side of the Grandioso Apartments, near the pond, and find the yellow electrical box under the big panels.

steps.t: Repair the panels using 5 Wires and 2 Batteries
steps.go: Interact with the electrical box and use your Wires and Batteries when prompted.

name: Digging Up Dirt

steps.t: Locate the Santa Maria Houses in Old Town
steps.pin: Locate the Santa Maria Houses in Old Town
steps.go: Head to the Santa Maria Houses. Ground doors are sealed, so get on the roof from a neighbouring building.

steps.t: Locate the Dead Drop inside the courtyard
steps.pin: Locate the Santa Maria Houses in Old Town
steps.go: Cross the plank or open the roof hatch, drop inside, zipline down and clear the turret. The white dead drop is in the sandy courtyard.

notes: Small detail difference: wiki says the drop is by a small fountain, reached via a roof hatch; All Things How says the middle of the sand-filled ground floor, via a plank and a hole. No dedicated pin for the dead drop, so the houses pin is reused.

name: Life of a Pharmacist

steps.t: Find the Arbusto Farmacia by the collapsed highway
steps.go: Go to the Farmacia on Piazza Arbusto by the collapsed highway, in through the front door and upstairs.

steps.t: Document the pharmacist's family
steps.go: Photograph the family pictures straight ahead at the top of the stairs.

steps.t: Document the pharmacist's skills
steps.go: Turn right from the photos and photograph the piano.

steps.t: Document the pharmacist's hobbies
steps.go: In the next room, photograph the plants on the cabinet by the left wall.

steps.t: Document the pharmacist's taste
steps.go: Turn round and photograph the table under the stairs at the back of the room.

notes: The wiki lists the four documents as hobbies, family, taste, skills; steps above follow PC Gamer's walking route. They can be done in any order. Only one pin exists, so it is reused for every photo.
